title: Reassess parked runtime observation retry deadlines after a wall-clock correction
outcome: The observation worker reconsiders pending UTC retry deadlines after a wall-clock correction while preserving event-driven waiting and retained report semantics.
acceptance: Deterministic clock and wait inputs cover a forward wall-clock correction during a park and demonstrate prompt reassessment of the due work.
Normal wake, shutdown, immutable retained report, and ambiguity budget behavior remain covered without a wall-clock timing assertion.
